items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: We had Jimmy Pala on the violin.

ctx.x: Ten years. Ten years. You played that quite a while. Yeah. The other night you mentioned the first time that Freddie Peppard came by and played with you. Was that at Parker's? Can you tell us about that again?

No, that was at the 101 Ranch. We only had string instruments there. And first Minetta was on the piano, then John Bean was on the drum. Old man Bean, Tarcum, on the drum. And I was playing the guitar then. Wasn't I playing? Yeah, I was playing the guitar then. And then we had the old man Willie O'Pri on the clarinet, sax. And we didn't have nothing. We had Jimmy Pala on the violin. Jimmy Pala. I got Jimmy for you. Yeah, you got Jimmy for you.

And then after, a little running come in. Yeah. Old man officer got a running and he had the boys, what they call him, he packs up his instrument. The gold's art. And you went behind and crossed the 25 and that was old John. That was George. That guy right.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: He played violin with me over there.

ctx.x: Were there some barber shops around the Big 25 or Elk Place or something? Yeah, but I didn't know none of them.

The musicians? And they didn't have no musicians. They didn't hang out? They didn't even bum in the barber shop? No. They bum around the 25-hour ballroom like that, you know. Not no barber shop, no. Well, what about Jimmy Palau? Now Jimmy Palau was a violin player. He was a good violin player. He played with me. Oh, yeah? Yeah, they played with me at Harry Park and Charlie Park. He played violin with me over there. They, uh, uh, they fired, uh, one time they, uh, they had gotten a humbug. He'd gotten a humbug…
Did they ever have any solo players then? No. Did they have any solo players? Solo, no. No. Not as I love, no. No. Tom Mitchell used to tell me about them. He said you didn't have a band on them.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: We had, we had Jimmy Palau.

ctx.x: Did you have a violin in your band that everyone wanted to?
Um, yeah, we did. That's right. We had, we had Jimmy Palau. Oh, yeah. Jimmy Palau played Bobby. I believe he's dead.
Yeah, I never really get the door ever hearing.
